test_title: PYST 4: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that has the same relation between the words as the relation between the words of the given pair.

Bonnet : Car
solution:
Bonnet is the part of the Car.

Similarly;

Kitchen is the part of the Home.

Hence, **"Kitchen : Home"** is the correct answer.
